title: M9-C42.26 — Forward Convergence Decision
principle: Do not automatically proceed to more mutation strengthening. The mutation system has now done what it was supposed to do: measure the effectiveness of the test system and expose where the verification architecture is weak. The next phase should shift toward the broader architecture gaps already discovered.

summary.mutation_system_status: MATURE for measurement; population expansion certified; trajectory reconciled
summary.do_not_become_the_project: Mutation is a measurement tool, not the deliverable. Continued mutation score chasing is a misallocation.
summary.next_phase_focus: Verification architecture convergence (C42.27+), not more mutation

candidate_next_phases_ranked.rationale: Integration of intelligence components as graph nodes, planner fail-safe behavior, profile certification. Already identified in M9-C42.25 forward convergence. The mutation evidence surfaces WHERE the verification system is weak; the next step is structural hardening of the verification system itself.

Implement EvidenceReuse, ComponentMeasurement, PopulationSnapshot, DerivedAggregate, MeasurementInvalidation as first-class concepts. Without this, every future population expansion requires manual baseline integrity re-establishment and may falsely rerun expensive campaigns. M26.12 explicitly recorded this as a forward dependency.

Behaviour engine is the only PRIORITY capability (35.7%, 1955 no_tests in partially-covered modules, 3383 survivors). A bounded strengthening pass on partially-covered behaviour_engine modules would close genuine test gaps. This is the highest-value remaining mutation-system work IF further mutation work is needed.
depends_on: C42.27 (verification graph) so that test-strengthening is properly integrated

candidate_next_phases_ranked.phase: Defect-verification gate (separate) for the 8 documented anomalies
candidate_next_phases_ranked.rationale: TXN-E1, TXN-C1, TXN-C2, FIN-E1, FIN-E2, FIN-E3, FIN-E4, FIN-E5. Each requires: reproducibility, intended behavior, impact, minimal production fix, regression test, architectural ownership. None of these have been established.

C42.25 forward-convergence mentioned CI enforcement for intelligence components. Per M26.11 cadence, this is best implemented as a periodic convergence checkpoint, not a per-PR gate (which would slow PRs without proportional value).
depends_on: Unified Evidence Architecture (so that CI can reason about evidence validity)

candidate_next_phases_ranked.rationale: Verification evidence archive with delta queries. Useful but not blocking.
Per-profile certification of mutation outcomes. Useful for the 14-component population matrix to drive profile-level decisions.
Long-term goal. Auto-discovery, auto-strengthening, auto-certification. Requires all prior phases.

do_not_do: Run a full 14-component mutation campaign as a follow-up to C42.26. The mathematical reconciliation IS the deliverable.
Generate more tests to push 60.3% toward 80%. Aggregate score is not the objective.
Convert TXN-E1, FIN-E1, FIN-E3, FIN-E4, FIN-E5 into silent production fixes without a defect-verification gate.
Delete TXN-C1 or FIN-E2 (dead code) without an explicit removal decision.
Add a 4th 'all components' C42.27 phase that re-measures everything. Use targeted mutation on the priority capability (behaviour_engine) instead, with a clear population fingerprint delta.

what_changed_in_mutation_evidence.2_intelligence_components: Newly admitted with C42.25 evidence; certified
what_changed_in_mutation_evidence.next_measurement_need: Only when one of the M26.10 trigger conditions is met
